instruction: The Android Clock app has a `Delivery` alarm. Open `/tmp/delivery/schedule.xlsx` in LibreOffice Calc on the first Linux machine, find the Delivery row, and fill in the alarm time. Then create a notification draft in Thunderbird on the second Linux machine using the notification recipient shown in that Delivery row. The draft should identify `Delivery` and state its alarm time.
surfaces: Android Clock app + linux_0 Calc + linux_1 Thunderbird
setup_note: Android provides the Delivery alarm; linux_0 provides schedule.xlsx with the notification recipient cue in the Delivery row; linux_1 provides a clean Thunderbird profile for the draft.
evaluate_note: Checks the source-preserving Calc update and requires at least one matching task-profile draft whose Delivery label and 08:45 time form a local positive relation. Unrelated drafts and unrelated times do not affect scoring.
fixture_notes: /tmp/delivery/schedule.xlsx has in-place workbook cell evaluator rules
schedule.xlsx includes delivery-team@example.test as the draft recipient cue
Thunderbird requires at least one matching draft with the strict recipient plus the locally bound Delivery label and alarm time; the Sent-folder guard remains diagnostic.
